There, lost in time and space, between rocks and plants, they sink back into their toxic habits. But this expedition could also help them to accept one another besides the loss.
items.title: Etincelo & Graviflux

items.overview: Isa gets ready for a date, trying to style herself to suit Rodrigo's tastes. When he arrives to pick her up, she is happy that he likes her look, but during the drive, she begins to realize that Rodrigo has no interest in getting to know her; as he gradually moves closer to her, she feels increasingly uncomfortable and trapped.
items.title: Reflections

items.overview: In the early morning, far away from home, a filmmaker talks about his mother, Nataša, from a window overlooking the city. As we watch the buildings and the neighborhood slowly waking up, a portrait of a woman emerges beyond what we see, and the story eventually leads him to something he has never said out loud before.
items.title: Nataša

items.overview: A death, a drug trip and an accident turn Marie's life upside down in a single day. She decides to return to her childhood home, her late grandmother's house in Slovakia. Accompanied by her ex-boyfriend Jerome, she begins hitchhiking. With no rules or clear plans, they travel from place to place, meeting unusual people along the way. As the journey continues, Marie takes greater risks and tests both her own limits and those of others, until things gradually spiral out of control.
items.title: Sunspots

items.overview: A couple retreats to an isolated property in the woods for a spontaneous weekend away. But when unexpected visitors disturb their solitude, the night descends into a deadly mystery where danger may be closer than they realize.
items.title: All Things Come To Night

items.overview: In a limestone quarry near Matlock, two worlds meet - the sharp clang of ice tools on rock, and the delicate bloom of wild orchids clinging to the same walls. A beautiful outdoor sport climbing, dry tooling and caving venue run by climbers, for climbers - isn't that the dream? ⁠When father and son team Nick and Sam Lister discovered that Masson Lees Quarry above Matlock in Derbyshire was up for sale, they decided to make that dream a reality.⁠
items.title: Axes and Orchids

items.title: Soap

However, making mistakes puts him under huge pressure and Alex must face his fear of not being accepted. Disharmony is a story about finding kindness and understanding in a loud world.
items.title: Disharmony

items.title: Bard Bar

items.title: The Stay

items.title: Night Fishers

items.overview: Featuring On para athlete Zach Friedley and 2x paralympian Dani Aravich, this film tracks the rise of para-athletes in the mountains as trail running races update their policies. The story focuses on Jahir, an Ecuadorian runner born with one leg, as he targets the UTMB OCC race. Through his eyes and with insights from UTMB race organizer, we witness the evolution of trail running and the vital importance of representation on the course.
items.title: We Belong

items.overview: Join Ed Jackson’s climb of the Matterhorn as he explores the values that have shaped his life after spinal cord injury: Purpose, Perspective, Progress and Perseverance.
items.title: Virtus - The Four P's

items.overview: In the centre of a rapidly moving city, an urban farmer teaches us what it means to slow down. Set within a community farm, the film explores how South Asian growing, cultural memory, and collective care create a space of belonging, while also speaking to the deeper questions of food justice in the city.
items.title: Touch Some Soil

items.overview: Guided by the resonant sound of singing bowls, we enter the inner world of professional freeskier Arianna Tricomi and find a place where snow transforms into a sanctuary and home.
items.title: Sound of Snow

items.overview: The film centers on Sisakawihay Marang Panay, following him as he navigates tribal ceremonies, university lecture halls, and daily family life. Through his native language, prayers, and rituals, he responds to the entrustments and needs of his people. Through these repeated acts, he fulfills his responsibilities as a Sisakawihay while reflecting on how traditional beliefs can continue to be practiced in the modern world.
items.title: Sisakawihay

items.overview: Following spinal cord damage that left her paralysed on her left side, Alice Sainsbury sets out to walk the Cornish Celtic Way. Through 125 miles of endurance, she surrenders to nature and learns to trust her body again. Shot on a combination of digital and hand-processed 16mm using Cornish seawater.
items.title: Slower Steps

items.overview: Jordan Wilson, a D.C. real estate executive who returns to Martha’s Vineyard and reconnects with her former summer love while fighting to save a historic Oak Bluffs inn.
items.title: Love on the Vineyard

items.overview: A poetic, experimental documentary set along the Cornish coast, where a collective of women gather at the edge of the Atlantic to rehearse an unlikely act, a synchronized swim in cold open water.
items.title: Saltwater Breath

items.overview: A man who is forced to kill his cat after it suddenly transforms into a creature tries to give it a proper farewell by burying the body with his friend.
items.title: EKEKEKEK

items.overview: A young Indigenous man who was adopted out of his family as a child undergoes a spiritual transformation as he searches to reconnect with his community.
items.title: Goat Song

items.overview: Horše Hiyis is a short film about intergenerational relationships to fire and to each other that are nurtured on rematriated land.
items.title: Horše Hiyis

items.overview: After a racially charged and traumatic audition, an Indigenous dancer spirals into a supernatural transformation in her NYC apartment.
items.title: Tȟáčȟa Škaŋ: Deer Movement

items.overview: When an unlikely crew of Native filmmakers gather to make a film, they become trapped inside the set and, one by one, begin to disappear.
items.title: The Whistling

items.overview: A child psychologist becomes entangled in a supernatural mystery when a troubled girl claims to be visited by an Apache deity, warning her of a monstrous evil hiding in plain sight.
items.title: Therapy

items.overview: Cutting back and forth between a dinner and fight to save a prisoner, Don Diego De La Vega battles two worlds, as an aristocrat and the vigilante known as “El Zorro.”
items.title: The Spirit of Zorro

items.overview: Three generations of a Tlingit family struggle with identity, trauma, and strained relationships until a journey to find a missing child offers hope for healing and cultural reconnection, bridging the divide between past and present.
items.title: Roots of a Cedar Tree

items.overview: Explore the importance of traditional subsistence practices, food sovereignty, and the preservation of Indigenous foodways in Arctic Alaska Native communities.
items.title: Niqipiaq: To Eat Real Food

items.overview: PERFECT STORM: THE MOVIE depicts the process of five young men with different backstories facing unexpected dangers. Notably, writer Jeon Hyo-jin of the representative Korean mystery variety show 'Crime Scene' series participated in screenwriting also participated in TXT's Hello Strangers. The five members appear as characters with their own stories, confronting incidents that shake their daily lives and dangers akin to a massive storm.
items.title: PERFECT STORM : THE MOVIE

items.overview: As voices and images move across deserts, mountains, and sea, searching for sara becomes a reflection on the gravitations we carry, are bound to, and remember within us.
items.title: searching for sara

items.overview: Heidi Walsh paddles some of the world’s steepest descents.
items.title: I Can Do It

items.overview: East Texans reflect upon how their communities and personal lives have been shaped by the pine forests that surround them.
items.title: Where the Pine Cones Lie

items.original_title: Made for Her: A Native American Fashion Film
items.overview: Two souls share a forbidden love. They decide to keep their relationship a secret. But when a Warrior claims one as his wife, her family plans a ceremony. In sadness, her lover runs away, becoming mortal. Her love must now save her.
items.title: Made for Her: A Native American Fashion Film

items.overview: Driven by her family roots to make sure no hide goes to waste, Kanina Terry not only masters tanning but also refines a winter frost-scraping method that transforms her process and deepens her love for the craft.
items.title: Frost Scraping

items.original_title: The Dark Days of Cassidy Krystian
items.overview: An Ojibwe woman is awakened to her past and its bloody aftermath.
items.title: The Dark Days of Cassidy Krystian

items.overview: Exposure has a way of nudging you with doubt — and at its most intense, it can reignite past trauma. As Arc’teryx athlete Tonje Kvivik’s career as a big mountain skier took her to greater heights, anxiety from her childhood began to reappear. In her quest to confront old fears, Tonje turns to her community for guidance: her grandfather, Arne, in Norway, and her close friend and teammate, snowboarder Spencer O’Brien. With their wisdom and encouragement as her guide, she steps into unfamiliar terrain and discovers an inner strength she never knew she had.
items.title: Etterklang

items.original_title: The Dawn Wall By Your Side
items.overview: The Dawn Wall is the hardest big wall in the world. After his failure in 2021, Seb Berthe sets sail again for a second attempt. Strongly supported by Soline Kentzel, Seb will have to give his all to, maybe, achieve his lifetime dream. But he is not the only one with a dream, and Soline also embarks on an extremely ambitious ascent. More than a story of performance, this documentary intimately and deeply questions, through Soline’s perspective, the meaning of the climbing partnership.
items.title: The Dawn Wall By Your Side

items.overview: Feature length documentary about Tom Waddington’s epic 2000 mile solo row across the North Atlantic. Journey with Tom as he aims to row himself from St John’s, Newfoundland, Canada to Penzance in the UK. Though wind, rain and big seas, battling the currents, tides and himself at times, Tom’s journey is far from a straight line.
items.title: The Darkest Ocean

items.original_title: Small People, Big Adventures - Currents of Curiosity
items.overview: Renowned explorer Leo Houlding embarks on a remarkable family expedition to the Calvados Island chain - one of the most remote inhabited regions on Earth, located 300km off the coast of Papua New Guinea. Here, money is meaningless and life is sustained through subsistence living, deep connection to nature and community exchange.
items.title: Small People, Big Adventures - Currents of Curiosity

items.overview: Follows trail runners as they take on a 42.1km trail run across the West Pennine Moors, carrying a 20kg sandbag between them — a physical representation of the weight of poor mental health, and the importance of sharing it. The film explores grief, male mental health, community and what can happen when people are willing to carry some of the weight for each other.
items.title: The Burden

items.overview: Join us for glacier camping and skiing big lines in remote Alaska.
items.title: Alaska

items.overview: Living on the edge of the Amazon, Maria’s life has always been tied to the forest. It was her playground as a child, later it became a resource she cut down to grow coca as Colombia fell into conflict. Now, she is helping bring the forest back to life. This intimate portrait of an ex-coca farmer offers a nuanced look at why people deforest, and how they can return to nature. The film follows Maria as she works with scientists using sound to explore how the landscape has recovered after the silence left by conflict and destruction. Through immersive sound design, we hear this transformation ourselves, carried into the forests and grasslands of Guaviare by the returning bird songs and the sounds of life renewed.
items.title: After the Silence

items.overview: A tale of a mother's struggle with depression, while a daughter discovers something about herself that she did not know.
items.title: Herminia

items.overview: Brad, a middle-aged errand runner, gets guilt-tripped by his dead Jewish Grandmother into believing his passive life embarrasses his ancestors, so he steals a Ferrari and tries to buy a minor league baseball team behind his wife's back.
items.title: Errand Guy

items.overview: HAVE YOU EVER HAD A HOMOEROTIC FRIENDSHIP? Two roommates begin an intense friendship until feelings jeopardize their relationship.
items.title: Feeling Blue

items.overview: An Indigenous man investigates a mysterious sound echoing through the city that reverberates through space and time.
items.title: The Boom

items.overview: A park ranger investigating mysterious disappearances encounters a dangerous predator after a jogger vanishes in the woods after dark.
items.title: After Dark

items.overview: After a piranha attack at Polar Beach, a young woman finds herself face-to-face with a mysterious woman in black. Alongside a friend, the figure reappears and reveals herself as a protective river entity, warning her about environmental imbalances. The young woman then realizes her deep connection with nature and with herself.
items.title: A Mulher da Polar

items.overview: A young zombie emerges from a cemetery and roams the streets in search of water in a city undergoing the early stages of urban verticalization. At a gothic party, he tries to reconnect with life, but the thirst persists as a memory of his condition. Yet, he still retains a spark of afterlife capable of offering a simple gesture of solidarity that restores him, if only for a moment, to his humanity.
items.title: Água que Passarinho Também Bebe

items.overview: In 2013 Danish adventurer, Thor Pedersen, left his loved ones behind and set off in an attempt to become the first person to visit every country in the world without flying. He wanted adventure, a title, and to show that the world is a much better place than is portrayed in the news. He got an experience that tested every layer of him as a human being.
items.title: The Impossible Journey

items.original_title: The Five Treasures of the Snows
items.overview: In 1955, the world’s third-highest mountain, Kangchenjunga, was climbed to within five metres of its summit by an expedition led by Charles Evans. They stopped just short out of respect for local beliefs that a protective deity lived there, providing the mountain communities with good harvests and wellbeing. This short film recounts the story of this landmark ascent and explores its cultural significance in the development of mountaineering, spotlighting the role of the fully integrated Sherpa team and the contribution of working-class climber Joe Brown.
items.title: The Five Treasures of the Snows

items.overview: History, science and exploration converged in a quest to find the lost camera of one of climbing’s most iconic photographers and cartographers, Bradford Washburn. Set against the backdrop of the pioneering lensmen’s storied 1937 Mount Lucania expedition, this film blurs the lines between adventure documentary, treasure hunt and meditation on why we risk everything to chase the improbable.
items.title: The Lost Cache

items.overview: A swashbuckling musical reimagining of Robert Louis Stevenson's classic pirate adventure. The story follows a young boy named Jim and his dad, Bertie, as they set off on a treasure hunt across the high seas. Along the way, they encounter sneaky pirates, a chatty seagull, and a very festive holiday surprise! The lively retelling is packed with original songs and laughs, celebrating the importance of family and listening to the ones you love most.
items.title: Cbeebies Panto: Treasure Island

items.overview: On-set veterinarian Goldie MacKenzie (Cahill) leaves the glamour of Hollywood behind to buy a family-run veterinary clinic in tight-knit Blue Dog Valley, arriving just in time for the town's cherished Christmas season. When Dr. Gable, the clinic's longtime owner, unexpectedly ends up out of town, Goldie is hosted by his handsome son Cohen (Walker), the black sheep of the family because he decided to forego their expectation of becoming a vet. Cohen and Goldie get off on the wrong foot, but when the folks of Blue Dog Valley cold shoulder "the newcomer," Cohen teams up with Goldie to win over even the frostiest of community members. Goldie is also aided by the mysterious canine she dubs Blue whose spontaneous appearances always seem to guide Goldie to exactly where she needs to be. As Goldie works hard to prove herself to the townspeople when furry and Christmas crises arise, she finds herself pulled towards the very heart of her new-found home... and a certain black sheep.
items.title: Christmas in Blue Dog Valley

items.overview: A man trapped in a recurring 10-second loop must confront the physical manifestations of his past choices before time runs out for good.
items.title: Ten (10)

The story focuses on Jahir, an Ecuadorian runner born with one leg, as he targets the UTMB OCC race. Through his eyes and with insights from UTMB race organizer, we witness the evolution of trail running and the vital importance of representation on the course.
results.title: We Belong

results.overview: Join Ed Jackson’s climb of the Matterhorn as he explores the values that have shaped his life after spinal cord injury: Purpose, Perspective, Progress and Perseverance.
results.title: Virtus - The Four P's

results.overview: In the centre of a rapidly moving city, an urban farmer teaches us what it means to slow down. Set within a community farm, the film explores how South Asian growing, cultural memory, and collective care create a space of belonging, while also speaking to the deeper questions of food justice in the city.
results.title: Touch Some Soil

results.overview: Guided by the resonant sound of singing bowls, we enter the inner world of professional freeskier Arianna Tricomi and find a place where snow transforms into a sanctuary and home.
results.title: Sound of Snow

results.overview: The film centers on Sisakawihay Marang Panay, following him as he navigates tribal ceremonies, university lecture halls, and daily family life. Through his native language, prayers, and rituals, he responds to the entrustments and needs of his people. Through these repeated acts, he fulfills his responsibilities as a Sisakawihay while reflecting on how traditional beliefs can continue to be practiced in the modern world.
results.title: Sisakawihay

results.overview: Following spinal cord damage that left her paralysed on her left side, Alice Sainsbury sets out to walk the Cornish Celtic Way. Through 125 miles of endurance, she surrenders to nature and learns to trust her body again. Shot on a combination of digital and hand-processed 16mm using Cornish seawater.
results.title: Slower Steps

results.overview: Jordan Wilson, a D.C. real estate executive who returns to Martha’s Vineyard and reconnects with her former summer love while fighting to save a historic Oak Bluffs inn.
results.title: Love on the Vineyard

results.overview: A poetic, experimental documentary set along the Cornish coast, where a collective of women gather at the edge of the Atlantic to rehearse an unlikely act, a synchronized swim in cold open water.
results.title: Saltwater Breath

results.overview: A man who is forced to kill his cat after it suddenly transforms into a creature tries to give it a proper farewell by burying the body with his friend.
results.title: EKEKEKEK

results.overview: A young Indigenous man who was adopted out of his family as a child undergoes a spiritual transformation as he searches to reconnect with his community.
results.title: Goat Song

results.overview: Horše Hiyis is a short film about intergenerational relationships to fire and to each other that are nurtured on rematriated land.
results.title: Horše Hiyis

results.overview: After a racially charged and traumatic audition, an Indigenous dancer spirals into a supernatural transformation in her NYC apartment.
results.title: Tȟáčȟa Škaŋ: Deer Movement

results.overview: When an unlikely crew of Native filmmakers gather to make a film, they become trapped inside the set and, one by one, begin to disappear.
results.title: The Whistling

results.overview: A child psychologist becomes entangled in a supernatural mystery when a troubled girl claims to be visited by an Apache deity, warning her of a monstrous evil hiding in plain sight.
results.title: Therapy

results.overview: Cutting back and forth between a dinner and fight to save a prisoner, Don Diego De La Vega battles two worlds, as an aristocrat and the vigilante known as “El Zorro.”
results.title: The Spirit of Zorro

results.overview: Three generations of a Tlingit family struggle with identity, trauma, and strained relationships until a journey to find a missing child offers hope for healing and cultural reconnection, bridging the divide between past and present.
results.title: Roots of a Cedar Tree

results.overview: Explore the importance of traditional subsistence practices, food sovereignty, and the preservation of Indigenous foodways in Arctic Alaska Native communities.
results.title: Niqipiaq: To Eat Real Food

results.overview: PERFECT STORM: THE MOVIE depicts the process of five young men with different backstories facing unexpected dangers. Notably, writer Jeon Hyo-jin of the representative Korean mystery variety show 'Crime Scene' series participated in screenwriting also participated in TXT's Hello Strangers. The five members appear as characters with their own stories, confronting incidents that shake their daily lives and dangers akin to a massive storm.
results.title: PERFECT STORM : THE MOVIE

results.overview: As voices and images move across deserts, mountains, and sea, searching for sara becomes a reflection on the gravitations we carry, are bound to, and remember within us.
results.title: searching for sara

results.overview: Heidi Walsh paddles some of the world’s steepest descents.
results.title: I Can Do It

results.overview: East Texans reflect upon how their communities and personal lives have been shaped by the pine forests that surround them.
results.title: Where the Pine Cones Lie

results.original_title: Made for Her: A Native American Fashion Film
results.overview: Two souls share a forbidden love. They decide to keep their relationship a secret. But when a Warrior claims one as his wife, her family plans a ceremony. In sadness, her lover runs away, becoming mortal. Her love must now save her.
results.title: Made for Her: A Native American Fashion Film

results.overview: Driven by her family roots to make sure no hide goes to waste, Kanina Terry not only masters tanning but also refines a winter frost-scraping method that transforms her process and deepens her love for the craft.
results.title: Frost Scraping

results.original_title: The Dark Days of Cassidy Krystian
results.overview: An Ojibwe woman is awakened to her past and its bloody aftermath.
results.title: The Dark Days of Cassidy Krystian

results.overview: Exposure has a way of nudging you with doubt — and at its most intense, it can reignite past trauma. As Arc’teryx athlete Tonje Kvivik’s career as a big mountain skier took her to greater heights, anxiety from her childhood began to reappear. In her quest to confront old fears, Tonje turns to her community for guidance: her grandfather, Arne, in Norway, and her close friend and teammate, snowboarder Spencer O’Brien. With their wisdom and encouragement as her guide, she steps into unfamiliar terrain and discovers an inner strength she never knew she had.
results.title: Etterklang

results.original_title: The Dawn Wall By Your Side
results.overview: The Dawn Wall is the hardest big wall in the world. After his failure in 2021, Seb Berthe sets sail again for a second attempt. Strongly supported by Soline Kentzel, Seb will have to give his all to, maybe, achieve his lifetime dream. But he is not the only one with a dream, and Soline also embarks on an extremely ambitious ascent. More than a story of performance, this documentary intimately and deeply questions, through Soline’s perspective, the meaning of the climbing partnership.
results.title: The Dawn Wall By Your Side

results.overview: Feature length documentary about Tom Waddington’s epic 2000 mile solo row across the North Atlantic. Journey with Tom as he aims to row himself from St John’s, Newfoundland, Canada to Penzance in the UK. Though wind, rain and big seas, battling the currents, tides and himself at times, Tom’s journey is far from a straight line.
results.title: The Darkest Ocean

results.original_title: Small People, Big Adventures - Currents of Curiosity
results.overview: Renowned explorer Leo Houlding embarks on a remarkable family expedition to the Calvados Island chain - one of the most remote inhabited regions on Earth, located 300km off the coast of Papua New Guinea. Here, money is meaningless and life is sustained through subsistence living, deep connection to nature and community exchange.
results.title: Small People, Big Adventures - Currents of Curiosity

results.overview: Follows trail runners as they take on a 42.1km trail run across the West Pennine Moors, carrying a 20kg sandbag between them — a physical representation of the weight of poor mental health, and the importance of sharing it. The film explores grief, male mental health, community and what can happen when people are willing to carry some of the weight for each other.
results.title: The Burden

results.overview: Join us for glacier camping and skiing big lines in remote Alaska.
results.title: Alaska

results.overview: Living on the edge of the Amazon, Maria’s life has always been tied to the forest. It was her playground as a child, later it became a resource she cut down to grow coca as Colombia fell into conflict. Now, she is helping bring the forest back to life. This intimate portrait of an ex-coca farmer offers a nuanced look at why people deforest, and how they can return to nature. The film follows Maria as she works with scientists using sound to explore how the landscape has recovered after the silence left by conflict and destruction. Through immersive sound design, we hear this transformation ourselves, carried into the forests and grasslands of Guaviare by the returning bird songs and the sounds of life renewed.
results.title: After the Silence

results.overview: A tale of a mother's struggle with depression, while a daughter discovers something about herself that she did not know.
results.title: Herminia

results.overview: Brad, a middle-aged errand runner, gets guilt-tripped by his dead Jewish Grandmother into believing his passive life embarrasses his ancestors, so he steals a Ferrari and tries to buy a minor league baseball team behind his wife's back.
results.title: Errand Guy

results.overview: HAVE YOU EVER HAD A HOMOEROTIC FRIENDSHIP? Two roommates begin an intense friendship until feelings jeopardize their relationship.
results.title: Feeling Blue

results.overview: An Indigenous man investigates a mysterious sound echoing through the city that reverberates through space and time.
results.title: The Boom

results.overview: A park ranger investigating mysterious disappearances encounters a dangerous predator after a jogger vanishes in the woods after dark.
results.title: After Dark

results.overview: After a piranha attack at Polar Beach, a young woman finds herself face-to-face with a mysterious woman in black. Alongside a friend, the figure reappears and reveals herself as a protective river entity, warning her about environmental imbalances. The young woman then realizes her deep connection with nature and with herself.
results.title: A Mulher da Polar

results.overview: A young zombie emerges from a cemetery and roams the streets in search of water in a city undergoing the early stages of urban verticalization. At a gothic party, he tries to reconnect with life, but the thirst persists as a memory of his condition. Yet, he still retains a spark of afterlife capable of offering a simple gesture of solidarity that restores him, if only for a moment, to his humanity.
results.title: Água que Passarinho Também Bebe

results.overview: In 2013 Danish adventurer, Thor Pedersen, left his loved ones behind and set off in an attempt to become the first person to visit every country in the world without flying. He wanted adventure, a title, and to show that the world is a much better place than is portrayed in the news. He got an experience that tested every layer of him as a human being.
results.title: The Impossible Journey

results.original_title: The Five Treasures of the Snows
results.overview: In 1955, the world’s third-highest mountain, Kangchenjunga, was climbed to within five metres of its summit by an expedition led by Charles Evans. They stopped just short out of respect for local beliefs that a protective deity lived there, providing the mountain communities with good harvests and wellbeing. This short film recounts the story of this landmark ascent and explores its cultural significance in the development of mountaineering, spotlighting the role of the fully integrated Sherpa team and the contribution of working-class climber Joe Brown.
results.title: The Five Treasures of the Snows

results.overview: History, science and exploration converged in a quest to find the lost camera of one of climbing’s most iconic photographers and cartographers, Bradford Washburn. Set against the backdrop of the pioneering lensmen’s storied 1937 Mount Lucania expedition, this film blurs the lines between adventure documentary, treasure hunt and meditation on why we risk everything to chase the improbable.
results.title: The Lost Cache

results.overview: A swashbuckling musical reimagining of Robert Louis Stevenson's classic pirate adventure. The story follows a young boy named Jim and his dad, Bertie, as they set off on a treasure hunt across the high seas. Along the way, they encounter sneaky pirates, a chatty seagull, and a very festive holiday surprise! The lively retelling is packed with original songs and laughs, celebrating the importance of family and listening to the ones you love most.
results.title: Cbeebies Panto: Treasure Island

results.overview: On-set veterinarian Goldie MacKenzie (Cahill) leaves the glamour of Hollywood behind to buy a family-run veterinary clinic in tight-knit Blue Dog Valley, arriving just in time for the town's cherished Christmas season. When Dr. Gable, the clinic's longtime owner, unexpectedly ends up out of town, Goldie is hosted by his handsome son Cohen (Walker), the black sheep of the family because he decided to forego their expectation of becoming a vet. Cohen and Goldie get off on the wrong foot, but when the folks of Blue Dog Valley cold shoulder "the newcomer," Cohen teams up with Goldie to win over even the frostiest of community members. Goldie is also aided by the mysterious canine she dubs Blue whose spontaneous appearances always seem to guide Goldie to exactly where she needs to be. As Goldie works hard to prove herself to the townspeople when furry and Christmas crises arise, she finds herself pulled towards the very heart of her new-found home... and a certain black sheep.
results.title: Christmas in Blue Dog Valley

results.overview: A man trapped in a recurring 10-second loop must confront the physical manifestations of his past choices before time runs out for good.
results.title: Ten (10)
